summary: DC Vote recently documented nine instances of congressional interference with District authority and outlined the current state of advocacy efforts, while the ACLU DC has raised concerns about the role of National Guard troops in the District. A senator has previously committed to prioritizing DC statehood legislation. Without statehood, the District's National Guard answers to the President, not to the officials D.C. residents elect.
